Working On Scnario Tool
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060610/9948689a27ae623276c7abaf9965d16801e0bda7.png"][/img][/p][p]Our number one goal was to speed up of Making the map.[/p][p][/p][p]Until now, the main story  Scripts was all hard-coded[/p][p][/p][p]With the help of a programmer, we have completed a tool that makes it easy to configure scripts in the map.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll let you know more when things go further.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also find the latest information on RedDawn here[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://x.com/RedDawn_Dev"]Red Dawn(@RedDawn_Dev) / X[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We are Trying to Develope Again...
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060610/96a27011f795c956825d544e3f2a3f2ae4630d8d.png"][/img][/p][p]Long time no see, gamers [/p][p][/p][p]who are looking forward to Red Dawn [/p][p][/p][p]I'm sorry for leaving the Steam page abandoned[/p][p]From now on, I'm going to manage the Steam page.[/p][p][/p][p]In fact, development has been disrupted for economic reasons until recently.[/p][p]For three years, we have not been able to compete in the government's Siwon project and have not been elected in the competition.[/p][p][/p][p]The former programmer developed it in parallel with Coupang Alba, but eventually quit because he couldn't stand it. [/p][p][/p][p]It would have been great if I could have given him even 500,000 won, whether it was a support project or a contest[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, we have recently found conditions to develop even for a very short time, so we are focusing on developing RedDawn.[/p][p][/p][p]I don't know if it's possible, but I'd like to show our game to gamers who still look forward to RedDawn[/p][p]This is a notice I wrote suddenly on a late summer night.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
